msg: warning: Variable p is used uninitialized!
reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE (NEW): 061fd0a353e.c (BusyBox hdparm). Uninitialized value on 'p' at line 27, when CONFIG_FEATURE_HDPARM_HDIO_SCAN_HWIF is defined. Same root cause as FAMILY_4: 'char *p' declared at line 7 without initialization, only conditionally assigned in case 'W'. In case 'R' (compiled when SCAN=true), 'if(!p)' at line 27 uses p without guaranteed initialization. Same bug as FAMILY_4 but at a different use site and gated by a different flag. This is the same NEW bug. CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED: SCAN=true is necessary and sufficient for the alarm at line 27.
